findings.ground: Public sigma plus relaxMaxSweeps set to one and repeatable relaxField re-entry from incomplete recover the accepted final-sweep pre-call field. Public topology, boundaryCells, neighborCounts, boundaryState, and the accepted specification then permit a separate same-discrete reconstruction of the post-smoother candidate and aggregate diagnostics without a solver contract change.

The accepted specification does not specify an independently solved continuum field reference, an independent continuum boundary-flux reference, analytic expected field or flux orders, or a justified order lower bound. Same-discrete reconstruction can establish implementation agreement and stopping-error behavior but cannot supply the registered spatial-accuracy reference.

attemptedRoutes.route: Set public relaxMaxSweeps to one, repeat public relaxField from incomplete, capture public sigma before the accepted one-sweep convergence call, and reconstruct the post-smoother candidate and aggregate diagnostics from public topology, boundary state, and the accepted specification.
attemptedRoutes.reason: This route is available and requires no solver contract change, but it replays the accepted discrete operator and therefore supplies implementation agreement and stopping-error evidence rather than an independent continuum/spatial field or flux accuracy reference, expected order, or justified lower bound.

attemptedRoutes.route: Run multiple grid levels while scaling the production relaxation tolerance with spacing and treat the resulting self-convergence slope as absolute accuracy.
attemptedRoutes.reason: Self-convergence is not an accuracy reference, and coupling solver tolerance to spacing can manufacture an apparent order from stopping error.
